blogs.title: Advances in Heart Disease Prevention
blogs.author: Dr. Jefferson George
blogs.summary: Latest research and recommendations for preventing heart disease through lifestyle modifications and early intervention.
blogs.content: Heart disease remains one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide. In this blog post, we explore the latest evidence-based strategies for heart disease prevention, including dietary recommendations, exercise guidelines, and risk factor management.

blogs.title: Understanding Modern Cardiac Imaging Techniques
blogs.author: Dr. Jefferson George
blogs.summary: An overview of current cardiac imaging technologies and their role in diagnosis.
blogs.content: Modern cardiac imaging has revolutionized how we diagnose and treat heart conditions. This post discusses various imaging techniques including CT, MRI, and nuclear imaging, their applications, and benefits.
